observedMetrics.title: The Enterprise AI Control Plane - Part 1/5

proposedActions.target: Nick Lambeth's reply to Aditya Singh
proposedActions.exactText: Agreed, Nick. Row-level policy in the Databricks catalog and Salesforce permissions each protect a local boundary; the harder failure appears when an agent combines a permitted read with a permitted CRM write. I would track cross-system privilege amplification, denial rate and p95 policy-evaluation latency, then require one action-time decision and receipt spanning both systems—otherwise two locally valid permissions can produce one globally invalid outcome.
